core_obligations: Lift the two points of the limit to a common finite index; separatedness of the transition morphism identifies their images.
Conclude the diagonal is closed using the generator property: a closed set meeting every generator image is everything; the affine diagonal criterion applied at finite level.
proof_roadmap: Point lift to finite level; transition separatedness forces agreement.
Diagonal closedness via generators and the affine case.
difficulty_reason: Single mechanism: lift a pair of points over the limit to a finite level, use separatedness of the transition map to make the two lifts agree, then conclude via the generator/density argument. No multi-lemma assembly.

compared.difference: The sibling descends separatedness of finite presentation along the limit; this lemma proves the limit itself is separated when transition maps are separated. Different direction of the same engine.
